description: A Kivy-based Python script demonstrating a Bezier curve with interactive sliders and draggable points.

classes.name: BezierTest
classes.description: A custom FloatLayout that displays a Bezier curve with draggable points and adjustable dash offsets.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: A Kivy App that initializes the BezierTest with a polygon resembling a Pacman shape.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BezierTest layout, sets up the Bezier curve, line, and sliders.

methods.name: _set_bezier_dash_offset
methods.description: Adjusts the dash length and offset of the Bezier curve based on slider value.

methods.name: _set_line_dash_offset
methods.description: Adjusts the dash length and offset of the line based on slider value.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch events to select and drag points on the polygon.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events to finalize point dragging.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Updates point positions as they are dragged and updates the Bezier and line accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main application layout with a polygon shaped like Pacman.
